_comment: REFERENCE FILE -- shows every configuration section HBlink4 understands, with example values. Do NOT copy this to config/config.json wholesale: the blacklist and repeater patterns below match invented ID ranges that may overlap your own repeaters, and the link/trunk examples point at hosts that do not exist. Start from config/config_sample.json and paste in only the sections you need. Full reference: docs/configuration.md.

connection_type_detection._comment: Categorize clients using self-reported RPTC metadata. BuenoDMR strict hotspot access defaults to true and denies non-hotspot/unknown clients after authentication and valid RPTC. The category is not hardware attestation.

dashboard._comment: OUTBOUND connection to the dashboard. HBlink4 is the client here: it dials the dashboard and pushes events to it. Naming convention: host_* = an address we connect out to, bind_* = an address we listen on (see bind_ipv4/bind_ipv6 under 'global'). host_ipv4/host_ipv6 are the dashboard's reachable address - NOT bind addresses, so never 0.0.0.0 or ::. The dashboard's matching listening socket is dashboard/config.json -> event_receiver.

dynamic_talkgroups._comment: Optional local join/leave control for one talkgroup. Disabled by default. A group voice PTT on slot/talkgroup joins this connection for receive; a group voice PTT on disconnect_talkgroup leaves receive for this connection only and is consumed locally.

blacklist._comment: EXAMPLE RANGES -- these IDs are invented for illustration. Replace them with IDs you actually want to refuse, or omit the section entirely.

patterns.name: Blocked Multiple Ranges
patterns.description: Example of multiple ranges in one pattern

repeater_configurations._comment: Patterns are tried in order and the FIRST match wins -- a repeater matched by a pattern never falls through to 'default'. The example ranges below are invented; if you copy them unchanged and one of your own repeater IDs falls inside a range, that repeater will be required to use the example passphrase and will fail to connect. Delete the patterns you do not need.
